sentences.text:
January, 2025
 The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.77 of 2025
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,
for granting of pre-arrest bail to the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 5 in Crime No.150 of 2024 on the file of the Kothaguda Police Station, Mahabubabad, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 417, 420 and 376(2)(n) read with 34 of the IPC.

2. Heard Sri Nallamasu Krishna, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Syed Yasan Manoon,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, appearing for respondent.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent- State submitted that accused No.1 was arrested on 04.01.2025 and a notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. (presently, Section 35(3) of the BNSS) has already been issued in respect of accused Nos.2 to 4.
3.

In view of the aforesaid submission and since the averments of the petition do not constitute offences under Section 376(2)(n) of the IPC, this Court deems it appropriate to direct petitioner No.5/accused No.5 to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 23.01.2025 between 11:00 a.m. and 05:00 p.m. and in turn, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 35 (3) of the BNSS (previously, Section 41-A of Criminal Procedure Code) and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, petitioner No.5/accused No.5 shall submit his defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
4. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.

_ _ K. SUJANA, J Date: 09.01.2025 gms Note:
